headline: Python source is present in registry records but the learning renderer does not present it as code; theory coverage is compressed far below the Stage 3 knowledge model.

systemic_findings.title: The renderer discards Python code semantics
systemic_findings.evidence:
ContentValue renders every array as

  • . On the live data-models page, the six Python lines appear as six bullet points. The worked-example section contains no 

     source block. Inline lessons render backticks as ordinary paragraph characters.
systemic_findings.impact: Indentation, block structure, copyability as one program, and the visual distinction between explanation and executable Python are lost. A learner can reasonably conclude that no Python code is provided.

systemic_findings.title: Published worked examples do not join to Stage 5 execution evidence
systemic_findings.evidence: Stage 5 contains author runs, independent reruns and execution_log_sha256 trace evidence, but zero of 26 Stage 9 worked-example sourceRefs point to stage-5/. Some records say runnable_python or list expected output without a verifiable run locator.
systemic_findings.impact: The Stage 0 rule that Python, trace and output be checked independently is not auditable from a learning page.

systemic_findings.title: Theory coverage was flattened during composition/integration
systemic_findings.evidence: Stage 3 defines 108 sourced knowledge blocks and 55 coursebook sections. Stage 9 exposes one short plain-text knowledge paragraph per lesson (26 total), no structured concept sections, and no direct coursebook or syllabus locator on those knowledge blocks.
systemic_findings.impact: Definitions, representations, invariants, alternatives, misconceptions and syllabus/coursebook links are not taught at the depth expected for Paper 4.

systemic_findings.title: Five lessons contain code only inside prose
systemic_findings.evidence: The whole worked example is a string. Code is embedded between backticks; linked-list labels its single semicolon-separated line as Python/pseudocode.
systemic_findings.impact: These lessons cannot support line highlighting, execution provenance, syntax checks or accessible code navigation.

systemic_findings.title: Release QA validated shape and routes but missed educational visibility
systemic_findings.evidence: The released 26/260 registry shape can pass while all worked Python is rendered as bullets or prose. The Visual Lab code panel displays method-step IDs such as array-append.step.contract rather than the worked Python source.
systemic_findings.impact: RELEASE_LOCKED overstates readiness for a Python-centred Paper 4 course.

stage_assessment.note: The contract explicitly requires Requirement -> design -> Python -> trace -> output/test -> evidence and selectable code.
The 108 knowledge blocks and 55 book sections are a sound source model, but Stage 9 does not expose their structure.
Method and marking design is useful, while Stage 4 explicitly defers execution verification.
Execution logs and independent reruns exist, but their code/run/fixture identities are not joined to published worked examples.
Composition artifacts contain method material, but published theory is one paragraph per lesson and code serialization is inconsistent.
Event visuals model state changes; they do not substitute for complete Python source and verified runs.
The runtime can replay deterministic events, but its code panel shows step IDs and does not execute or display the full lesson Python.
Integration preserved counts and routes while losing semantic code presentation and theory depth.

remediation_acceptance: Reopen Stage 9 release and mark the current manifest superseded until all P0 findings close.
Define a typed PythonExample contract with language, complete source, line IDs, fixtures, expected output, actual output, Stage 5 run locator and verification hash.
Render every PythonExample as a single accessible <pre><code> block that preserves indentation, supports horizontal scrolling on small screens, exposes line numbers and remains selectable/copyable.
Replace the five prose-embedded examples with the typed contract; linked-list must use valid Python or be explicitly labelled pseudocode, never both.
Create a deterministic join from all published examples to Stage 5 verified code/runs, or independently execute and freeze new examples where Stage 5 has no matching program.

Expand the knowledge layer from 26 summary paragraphs to a verifiable mapping of all 108 Stage 3 knowledge blocks, including coursebook section/page, syllabus objective, concept explanation, representation/invariant, misconception and a local example where applicable.
Add automated assertions for 26/26 semantic code blocks, 26/26 run-evidence joins, 108/108 knowledge dispositions, and direct source locators.
Run independent browser QA that checks what a learner sees, including Python indentation and code/theory visibility in both VI and EN, before issuing a replacement release manifest.
